gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.1: <Spongeguh> (muffled, through the bubbles) Hellooo out there! Sorry, we're still closed! Come back when you've saved the world, then we'll bake patties together!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.2: Bikini Bottom and Shell City open for you as soon as you have finished the Guhvatar story (The Legend of Guh).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.3: Not started yet, or a bit lost? The glowing cheese ball by the Nibble Mountain takes you to your story. After that you can come here as often as you like, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.poort.balk: Pink bubbles hold you back. Finish the Guhvatar story first, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_verhaal.standin.klaar: [stand-in] %s: done (this step is still being built).
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.uitleg: Mr. Krabguh is opening a second restaurant and needs a manager. Spongeguh is sure it will be him. But then King Neptuguh's crown disappears, and Mr. Krabguh gets the blame. You, Spongeguh and Patguh are going to bring it back: all the way to Shell City. In the Patty Wagon. What could possibly go wrong, nyeg?
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.uitleg: Deep under the islands of the Guh End lies Bikini Bottom, a little town under a giant soap bubble. The Krusty Nibble is looking for a new colleague, and Spongeguh Cheesepants can't wait to teach you everything. What could possibly go wrong, nyeg?
